plugin.name: NEKO Selfie Painter
plugin.description: Generates NEKO selfies through OpenAI-compatible, Alibaba Model Studio Qwen-Image, or ModelScope APIs and displays them in chat as Markdown images.
plugin.short_description: Generate and display NEKO selfies in chat
tools.take_selfie.description: Call when the user asks NEKO to take a selfie, pose for a photo, or generate an image of herself. scene describes location, clothes, pose, expression, or lighting; style is standard, mirror, or photo.
messages.sent: The selfie is already visible in chat. Do not repeat the image URL.
messages.diaryCleared: The current character's selfie journal was cleared.
errors.not_ready: The selfie plugin has not started yet.
errors.internal: An internal error occurred while generating the selfie: {error}
panel.title: NEKO Selfie Painter
panel.subtitle: Collect shared days, small highlights, and photos in a quiet life journal.
panel.generate.title: Generate selfie
panel.generate.scenePlaceholder: For example: sitting by the window at sunset, oversized sweater, smiling at the camera
panel.config.title: API and character settings
panel.config.apiKeyConfigured: Configured; leave blank to keep the current value
panel.config.publicBaseUrlHelp: Leave blank on desktop; set this only for remote or Docker deployments.
panel.config.secretWarning: An API key saved here is written to the local plugin configuration and is never echoed back. Prefer NEKO_SELFIE_PAINTER_API_KEY; Alibaba Model Studio also supports DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.
panel.recent.title: Recent images
panel.recent.empty: No selfies have been generated yet.
panel.recent.open: Click a thumbnail to open the full JPG
panel.diary.emptyTitle: Today is still a clean page
panel.diary.emptyDescription: Successful selfies are recorded here per character. Recent chat is filtered only while generating and is not written to the journal.
panel.diary.albumHint: Selfies will be linked to journal events. For now, recent JPGs are shown here.
panel.diary.albumEmptyHint: Open Take a photo to keep the first one.
panel.diary.settingsComing: Control recent context and the local selfie journal.
panel.diary.privacyNotice: When recent context is enabled, up to three filtered visual excerpts are sent to the configured image service with the prompt. Raw chat is not stored in the journal.
panel.diary.autoRecord: Use visual details from recent conversation while generating
panel.diary.autoPhoto: Save successful selfies to the local journal
panel.diary.clearConfirm: Clear every selfie-journal entry for the current character? This cannot be undone.
panel.diary.coverSubtitle: Keep shared days, bright moments, and photographs in a story told one page at a time.
panel.diary.openBook: Tap right to open, or left to visit the last page
panel.selfie.readyHint: The image API is configured. Photos can be generated and sent to chat.
panel.selfie.missingHint: Open Settings, add the API details and key, then save before taking a photo.
panel.messages.generated: Selfie generated and sent to chat
panel.messages.diaryCleared: The current character's selfie journal was cleared
